name: brickproof-adb
description: Lets an agent operate your own Android devices over ADB: screen, input, installs and package changes. Reading the device stays automatic; input, installs, package changes, file transfers, shell and connecting new devices are reviewed. The server adds its own guard rails: dry run by default, a protected set read off the device, a network guard and one-call rollback. Off until you turn it on.
saferAlternatives: adb_install, and adb_app disable, uninstall, enable, restore and clear, change nothing without dry_run=false; launch, stop and backup act at once. adb_app refuses packages the device needs and keeps a snapshot; action=restore rolls it back.
adb_shell and adb_uninstall stay off until the operator enables them with brickproof-adb set; no tool can turn them on.
Start with adb_devices, adb_screenshot and adb_ui_dump; they only read the device.

Review defaults match the brickproof-adb package under any recognized package launcher. The Claude Desktop extension and the Home Assistant app start the server without one and keep Guard's normal handling.
